name: 88401 · Tucumcari, NM
findings: ZIP 88401 (Tucumcari) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 88401 (Tucumcari) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
55% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 88401 (Tucumcari) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.6 times the typical level).
